children.name: Morph Price Adjustment
children.local_notes: Sets this morph to its chargen price: 0 EP CP / 4 = 0 points. Package value 79, adjustment -79. The package total says what the body is; the chargen price is all you pay for it, and only at creation (Part III).

local_notes: Pure software (EP 1e, 0 CP / 0 pts at chargen). No ST, HT, HP, or FP - there is no body. Exists on a server or in mesh inserts; acts through the mesh, simulspace, and puppeted robots. Basic Speed is a property of the hardware, not the mind.
